### Discovery & Translational Science

* **[Navigating ultralarge virtual screening and the evolving landscape of drug targets](https://www.nature.com/articles/d41573-026-00155-w)** — *Nature Reviews Drug Discovery / PubMed*
  * Computational reviews highlight key methodologies for searching billions of virtual molecules and mapping modern disease-associated targets to accelerate early-stage drug discovery.

* **[Biotech]** **[Covalent BAX inhibitor offers cytoprotective therapeutic avenue](https://www.nature.com/articles/d41573-026-00156-9)** — *Nature Reviews Drug Discovery*
  * Preclinical findings demonstrate that a novel, covalent BAX inhibitor successfully suppresses apoptotic pathways, conferring cytoprotection in tissue-injury and cell-death models.

* **[Suppressor tRNA strategy rescues cystic fibrosis nonsense mutations](https://www.nature.com/articles/d41573-026-00153-y)** — *Nature Reviews Drug Discovery*
  * Translational review outlines how engineered suppressor tRNAs can successfully read through premature termination codons to restore functional CFTR protein synthesis.

* **[Targeting norovirus RNA structures as an antiviral mechanism](https://www.nature.com/articles/d41573-026-00154-x)** — *Nature Reviews Drug Discovery*
  * Preclinical structural biology work highlights therapeutic small molecules capable of binding and disrupting highly conserved secondary and tertiary RNA structures in the norovirus genome.

* **[Decidual-like CD9⁺ NK cells enriched in melanoma microenvironments](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.09.18.26363442)** — *bioRxiv*
  * Flow cytometry and multiplex immunohistochemistry identified CD56BrightCD16⁻CD49a⁺CD9⁺ decidual-like natural killer (dl-NK) cells within male and female melanomas across primary, lymph node, and distant metastatic sites.
  * Research reveals these dl-NK cells are rare in peripheral blood and acquire their defining CD9 marker directly through contact with melanoma cells.
  * In a clinical cohort treated with tumor-infiltrating lymphocyte (TIL) therapy, elevated intratumoral dl-NK frequency correlated with progressive disease.

* **[Menopause-linked proteomic signatures map to cognitive decline and dementia risk](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41591-026-04648-4)** — *Nature Medicine*
  * Proteomic profiling of nearly 15,000 women identified hormone-associated molecular shifts during menopause that correlate with poor late-life cognitive performance.
  * The identified blood-based biomarkers suggest potential therapeutic targets for preserving cognitive function and addressing postmenopausal brain aging.

* **[HealthFlux: A pan-modal clinical world model for latent health dynamics](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.09.19.26363460)** — *bioRxiv*
  * Researchers developed HealthFlux, a state-space model trained on 5,647 features across 11 modalities (including clinical records, genomics, proteomics, and MRI) from 502,166 UK Biobank participants.
  * The model successfully predicted 195 diseases and five-year mortality with a mean AUROC of 0.816, significantly outperforming the previous state-of-the-art model (0.715).

* **[Preclinical warning: Mouse dehydration caused by trapped air in water bottles](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.06.15.732413)** — *bioRxiv*
  * Investigation of unexpected mouse deaths in climate-controlled animal facilities revealed that air bubbles frequently become trapped in the drinking tubes of standard water bottles, blocking flow and causing severe dehydration.
  * Inserting a coiled wire inside the tube successfully dislodged the bubbles and ensured continuous, unrestricted water access.

* **[RNA modification m6A regulates macrophage efferocytosis in atherosclerosis](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.09.19.749544)** — *bioRxiv*
  * Integrated m6A quantitative trait loci (m6A QTLs) with coronary artery disease GWAS data to construct a high-resolution map of macrophage m6A modifications.
  * In a myeloid-specific knockout mouse model (Mettl14ᶠ/ᶠ LysMᶜʳᵉ), loss of m6A altered macrophage efferocytosis and accelerated atherosclerotic plaque progression by releasing translational restraint on SIRPα.

* **[Physiological variability and mechanistic rationale of Alzheimer's biomarker ratios](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.09.18.26363412)** — *bioRxiv*
  * Quantitative analysis demonstrates that individual physiological factors (such as plasma/CSF volume and elimination kinetics) introduce noise into single-biomarker clinical trial measurements.
  * Results prove that ratio-based normalization (such as Aβ42/Aβ40) mechanistically cancels out this inter-individual physiological variability, boosting diagnostic and therapeutic monitoring sensitivity in homogeneous trial cohorts.

* **[Centenarians maintain cognitive health by blocking tau propagation or resisting Aβ](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.09.18.26363376)** — *bioRxiv*
  * Neuropathological and cognitive analysis of 112 centenarians revealed two distinct AD resistance pathways: 44% of cognitively normal centenarians resisted amyloid-β accumulation, while 28% accumulated Aβ but resisted downstream p-tau propagation into the hippocampus.

* **[AI-ECG model detects and predicts hypertrophic cardiomyopathy across genotypes](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.09.12.26362902)** — *bioRxiv*
  * Evaluated a validated AI-ECG model in 1,095 genotype-positive individuals with sarcomere variants associated with hypertrophic cardiomyopathy (HCM).
  * The model successfully identified phenotypic positivity at first assessment and predicted the future development of HCM in phenotype-negative carriers.

* **[DMT and harmine formulation alters peak psychedelic EEG topography](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42768932)** — *PubMed*
  * Clinical EEG study showing that an N,N-Dimethyltryptamine/harmine co-formulation significantly shifts transient microstate topography sequences during peak drug effects.

* **[Gβγ dimer regulates neuronal KV7.2/7.3 channels to increase M-current](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.09.15.751787)** — *bioRxiv*
  * Co-expression of Gβγ with KV7.2/7.3 in Xenopus oocytes doubled the maximal M-current.
  * The mechanism involves two distinct pathways: increasing plasma membrane channel density and stabilizing channel-PIP₂ coupling.

* **[AI tool enhances esophageal cancer detection on noncontrast CT scans](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41591-026-04656-4)** — *Nature Medicine*
  * Validation of "Esophageal AI-Guided malignant Lesion Evaluation" showed high sensitivity and specificity for identifying esophageal cancer on standard noncontrast CT.

* **[Mendelian randomization dissects opposing effects of T2D components on AAA](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.09.18.26363427)** — *bioRxiv*
  * Two-sample Mendelian randomization using 449 genetic instruments showed no net association between overall Type 2 diabetes liability and abdominal aortic aneurysm (AAA) risk (OR 1.00).
  * However, pathway-specific analysis revealed that individual metabolic components (hyperglycemia vs. insulin resistance vs. insulin sensitivity) exert contrasting, opposing forces on AAA development.

* **[Transcriptomic features show modest incremental predictive value in bladder cancer immunotherapy](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.09.14.26363060)** — *bioRxiv*
  * Reanalysis of 298 patients in the IMvigor210 trial (atezolizumab) found that knowledge-guided microenvironment gene-set features improved prediction (AUPRC +0.058) over clinical variables alone, but yielded minor gains (+0.011 to +0.016) once TMB and PD-L1 expression were included.
  * IL-6/JAK/STAT3 signaling emerged as the most recurrent predictive biological pathway.

* **[Causal multi-modal AI model stratifies residual risk in HR⁺/HER2⁻ early breast cancer](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.09.15.26362492)** — *bioRxiv*
  * Validated "Ataraxis Breast CTX", an AI model combining clinical data and H&E histopathology features, on 556 patients from the Phase III UNIRAD trial.
  * The model successfully stratified residual recurrence risk in high-risk patients on standard adjuvant chemoendocrine therapy, identifying candidates for treatment escalation (such as CDK4/6 inhibitors or everolimus).

* **[Lifespan EEG reference charts expose aperiodic confounds in neural biomarkers](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.09.19.26363459)** — *bioRxiv / bioRxiv / bioRxiv*
  * Large-scale normative brain reference charts (N = 22,094; ages 1–100) reveal that conventional alpha- and beta-band analyses are heavily confounded by age-dependent, non-linear shifts in the aperiodic 1/f background spectrum.
  * Isolating periodic oscillations from aperiodic background activity resolved previous discrepancies in neurological and neuropsychiatric disorder-specific biomarker models.

* **[Inotropic effects of 3-hydroxybutyrate in rodent heart explained](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.09.15.751359)** — *bioRxiv*
  * Pressure-volume and isolated left ventricular trabeculae analyses show 3-hydroxybutyrate increases left ventricular end-systolic elastance by 34% and improves ventriculo-arterial coupling, indicating direct myocardial inotropy rather than simple peripheral vasodilation-induced unloading.

### Early Trials — Phase I–II

* **[Big Pharma]** **[Roche dual GLP-1/GIP agonist enicepatide shows strong Phase II efficacy](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2102333999083368838)** — *X / BioStocks*
  * Enicepatide achieved a mean HbA1c reduction of 2.65% and a mean weight loss of 15.5% at the highest 24 mg dose after 48 weeks in patients with type 2 diabetes and obesity.
  * Weight loss did not reach a plateau at 48 weeks. The treatment discontinuation rate due to adverse events was 2% in the enicepatide arms versus 0% in placebo.

* **[Trastuzumab, nivolumab, and chemotherapy combo active in HER2⁺ biliary tract cancer](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41591-026-04679-x)** — *Nature Medicine*
  * A Phase Ib/II trial evaluating first-line trastuzumab, nivolumab, gemcitabine, and cisplatin in HER2-positive unresectable biliary tract cancer demonstrated encouraging clinical response rates.
  * Higher HER2 expression levels were directly associated with increased clinical benefit.

* **[Chronic intracranial neural dynamics forecast OCD deep brain stimulation response](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.09.18.26363320)** — *bioRxiv*
  * Analyzed ~120,000 hours of intracranial recordings from 24 patients receiving ventral capsule/ventral striatum DBS for treatment-resistant OCD.
  * Circadian neural features prior to stimulation onset predicted eventual clinical response. Within the first two weeks of stimulation, reductions in neural predictability correlated with long-term symptom improvement.

* **[Naive T cell-depleted HSCT allows immunosuppression withdrawal in solid organ transplant](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42768153)** — *PubMed*
  * A clinical case report highlights the feasibility of using naive T cell-depleted hematopoietic stem cell transplantation to induce immune tolerance and minimize/withdraw maintenance immunosuppression after solid organ transplantation.

### Late & Pivotal Trials — Phase III

* **[Biotech]** **[Beacon Therapeutics' XLRP gene therapy laru-zova succeeds in Phase III](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/beacon-xlrp-laru-zova-phase-3-study-results/830918/)** — *BioPharma Dive*
  * Laruparetigene zovaparvovec (laru-zova), an investigational gene therapy for X-linked retinitis pigmentosa (XLRP), met its primary endpoint in a late-stage pivotal study.
  * A significantly higher proportion of treated participants read at least 15 more letters on a low-light visual acuity test compared to the untreated control group after 12 months.
  * Adverse events were reported as predominantly mild-to-moderate. Beacon plans to start a rolling BLA submission by the end of the year.

* **[Biotech]** **[Moderna mRNA CMV vaccine misses Phase III endpoint](http://sciencebasedmedicine.org/vaccineadvocatescult/?utm_source=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_campaign=vaccineadvocatescult)** — *Science-Based Medicine*
  * Moderna's CMV vaccine candidate, mRNA-1647, failed to meet its primary efficacy endpoint of preventing primary CMV infection in the Phase III trial (NCT05085366).
  * The trial enrolled ~7,500 CMV-seronegative female participants aged 16 to 40 years, randomized to receive three doses of mRNA-1647 or placebo.

### Regulatory & Approvals

* **[Big Pharma]** **[FDA approves Eli Lilly’s advanced breast cancer combination](https://www.statnews.com/2026/09/21/biotech-news-lilly-breast-cancer-combo-wins-approval/?utm_campaign=rss)** — *STAT+*
  * The FDA approved Eli Lilly’s new combination regimen targeting patients with advanced forms of breast cancer.

* **[Biotech]** **[Grail’s Galleri multi-cancer early detection test heads to FDA Advisory Committee](https://www.statnews.com/2026/09/21/grail-galleri-fda-advisory-committee-meeting-documents/?utm_campaign=rss)** — *STAT+ / Nature Medicine*
  * Shares of Grail rose ahead of an upcoming FDA advisory committee meeting reviewing its Galleri multi-cancer early detection (MCED) blood test.
  * Data from the PATHFINDER 2 and NHS-Galleri trials provide clinical performance, safety, and implementation metrics, but highlight the remaining hurdle of demonstrating population-level survival benefit.

* **[Big Pharma]** **[Par Pharmaceutical recalls dexmedetomidine lots over particulate matter](http://www.fda.gov/safety/recalls-market-withdrawals-safety-alerts/par-health-issues-voluntary-nationwide-recall-two-lots-dexmedetomidine-hcl-09-sodium-chloride)** — *FDA Recall*
  * Par Health issued a voluntary nationwide recall for two lots of Dexmedetomidine HCl in 0.9% Sodium Chloride Injection (400 μg/100 mL) due to the presence of particulate matter identified as cellulose or stopper material.

* **[Biotech]** **[Otsuka ICU Medical recalls saline injection lot due to potassium chloride mix-up](http://www.fda.gov/safety/recalls-market-withdrawals-safety-alerts/otsuka-icu-medical-llc-issues-voluntary-nationwide-recall-09-sodium-chloride-injection-usp-due)** — *FDA Recall*
  * Otsuka ICU Medical recalled one lot of 0.9% Sodium Chloride Injection, USP (100 mL) due to a product mix-up where overwrapped bags may contain 10 mEq Potassium Chloride Injection instead of saline.

### Business & Strategy

* **[Big Pharma]** **[Novo Nordisk pivots strategy to ward off investor panic over semaglutide patent cliff](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/novo-capital-markets-day-obesity-sales-outlook/830882/)** — *BioPharma Dive / X / BioStocks*
  * During its London Capital Markets Day, Novo Nordisk shared plans to launch more than five "multi-blockbusters" by 2030 and generate over $23 billion in annual sales by 2035 from its current pipeline.
  * The strategic expansion includes developing new products marketed more like consumer goods than traditional pharmaceuticals to absorb impending semaglutide patent expirations.
  * Investor reaction remained cold, with shares dropping 8% following the presentation, driven by concerns that upcoming launches like CagriSema will not offset immediate market share losses to Eli Lilly. UBS' Michael Yee labeled Novo Nordisk a "value trap."

* **[Biotech]** **[Telix strategy under scrutiny following ITM radiopharmaceutical deal](https://x.com/JacobPlieth/status/2102030722454188516)** — *X / JacobPlieth*
  * Industry analysis suggests Telix Pharmaceuticals pursued its acquisition of ITM primarily to secure its ¹⁷⁷Lu supply network rather than to advance a "me-too" Lutathera generic candidate via a formal NDA.
  * With one off-patent and two generic alternatives already on the market, pursuing a standard Lutathera me-too NDA is unlikely to be a strategic priority for Telix.

* **[Framework for platform biotech business development outreach](https://x.com/andrewpannu/status/2102040209768534314)** — *Andrew Pannu / X*
  * Commentary from Andrew Pannu notes that while multi-disease platforms offer broad applicability, biotechs risk analysis paralysis when attempting to structure pharma partnerships.
  * Recommends systematically mapping target pharma pipelines (>6,300 active assets across top 25 pharma companies, including ~2,000 preclinical programs) to tailor platform capabilities to a counterparty's specific strategic interests.

### Public Health & Policy

* **[Congressional pushback on proposed political review panel for NIH grants](https://www.statnews.com/2026/09/21/trump-plan-for-commission-to-review-nih-grants-push-back/?utm_campaign=rss)** — *STAT+ / Science*
  * Members of Congress and the academic scientific community are strongly opposing a reported Trump administration plan to create an executive-agency board composed of political appointees to hold final veto power over all NIH grants.
  * The proposed board reportedly lists Jay Bhattacharya as a potential member.

* **[New federal autism committee chair appointed despite leucovorin ties](https://www.statnews.com/2026/09/22/health-news-federal-autism-committee-head-has-financial-ties-to-leucovorin/?utm_campaign=rss)** — *STAT+*
  * RFK Jr. has appointed pediatric neurologist John Gaitanis to chair the Interagency Autism Coordinating Committee, which oversees the allocation of approximately $2 billion in federal autism funding.
  * The appointment is drawing scrutiny due to Gaitanis' financial ties to leucovorin, a medication controversial in alternative autism therapies.

* **[Mass General Brigham study reveals major financial tradeoffs in Trump drug pricing deals](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/trump-mfn-drug-deals-medicare-savings/830922/)** — *BioPharma Dive*
  * Analysis of the White House's "most-favored-nation" (MFN) drug pricing deals with 26 pharma companies indicates that the agreements could paradoxically block pre-existing federal cost-reduction plans.
  * According to a Mass General Brigham study, the current MFN structure could reduce projected Medicare savings by up to 80% due to compromises made with mid-size firms on state Medicaid pricing.

* **[HHS Teen Pregnancy Prevention program accused of citing fake AI-generated references](http://sciencebasedmedicine.org/hidden-in-plain-cite-hhs-backs-teen-pregnancy-program-priorities-with-phantom-references/?utm_source=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_campaign=hidden-in-plain-cite-hhs-backs-teen-pregnancy-program-priorities-with-phantom-references)** — *Science-Based Medicine*
  * A federal judge accused the HHS Office of Population Affairs of utilizing non-existent, potentially AI-generated literature references in two Notices of Funding Opportunity (NOFOs) to justify shifting strategic priorities for Teen Pregnancy Prevention program grants.

* **[Slight protective effect of influenza vaccination shown in hospitalized Brazilian patients](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.09.15.26362995)** — *bioRxiv*
  * Retrospective analysis of Brazilian patients hospitalized for severe acute respiratory infection (SARI) from 2023 to 2025 showed that a single dose of the trivalent influenza vaccine reduced adverse outcomes by 10–13%.
  * A two-dose regimen significantly reduced SARI mortality by 32% and ICU admissions by 52%, amid a drop in national vaccine coverage from 70% in 2023 to 40–50% in 2025.

* **[U.S. cohort study maps COVID-19 risk factors in the post-vaccine era](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.09.18.26363440)** — *bioRxiv*
  * A retrospective PCORnet cohort study analyzing adult COVID-19 cases from April 2022 to March 2025 quantified the persistent, independent risk of hospitalization and 30-day mortality associated with age and underlying medical conditions in a highly immune population.

***

**Worth watching:** Roche's Phase II enicepatide weight loss curve (-15.5% at 48 weeks without a plateau) suggests it could emerge as a powerful competitive threat in the next-generation obesity landscape if Phase III trials maintain this trajectory and low discontinuation rate.

- Pure Science
    - [This Machine Made Wartime Germany (Almost) Impossible to Defeat](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JsBZOcqZerk) -- Veritasium
        - The German Enigma machine encrypted messages using a complex system of interchangeable rotating rotors, a plugboard that swapped letter pairs, and a reflector that made encryption reciprocal but fundamentally prevented any letter from mapping to itself.
        - Polish mathematicians, including Marian Rejewski, first cracked the early Enigma by utilizing permutation theory and group theory to exploit the German military's practice of double-enciphering the individual message keys at the start of transmissions.
        - Alan Turing and Gordon Welchman at Bletchley Park designed the electromechanical "Bombe" machine, which drastically accelerated the decryption process by searching for logical contradictions in rotor settings using "cribs" (guessed plaintext segments) and electrical feedback loops.
        - To overcome the added complexity of the German Navy's four-rotor Enigma, codebreakers combined the Bombe's cryptanalysis with captured codebooks, meteorological data, and specialized parsing of highly formatted short-signals.
    - [Where Does the Quantum World End and Ours Begin? | PODCAST: The Joy of Why](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1rqpS2WAb0o) -- Quanta Magazine
        - Theoretical physicist Jonathan Halliwell explains that quantum decoherence is the key mechanism driving the transition from quantum wave-like behavior to the classical macroscopic world, occurring when a quantum system's phase relations are dispersed into its surrounding environment.
        - The transition from quantum probability to classical certainty does not require a conscious observer, as any physical interaction with environmental particles (like photons or air molecules) acts as an environmental "measurement" that destroys quantum superposition.
        - Halliwell utilizes the "decoherent histories" (or consistent histories) framework to mathematically describe how classical-like trajectories and definite probabilities emerge from a quantum system without relying on the traditional Copenhagen wave-function collapse.
        - The discussion highlights the fundamental paradoxes of quantum measurement, emphasizing how looking at or interacting with a system inherently alters its state by forcing a choice among quantum possibilities.
